channel.title: Palimpsest Live Eval Findings
channel.description: Dated analysis from sealed AI evaluations.

item.title: A clean run does not erase a failed one
item.description: Mistral Nemo passed all 41 prompt arms in the latest canonical run. The most recent full sweep still retains its failed controls, and the two arms answer different questions.

item.title: Zero observed refusals is not zero uncertainty
item.description: 3 control-clean model runs observed 0 refused families out of 34, yet each zero result still carries a Wilson 95% upper bound of 10.2%. That interval is part of the finding, not fine print.
